modifications: None. The regular TrueType font and full license are byte-identical to the official Google Fonts downloads.
distribution: Vite emits the imported font into dist/assets and copies the complete license to dist/licenses/PressStart2P-OFL.txt. Native builds include dist in their frontend bundle; an identical docs/licenses/PressStart2P-OFL.txt is installed as a readable resource through the existing licenses resource mapping.
runtime: All UI uses bundled Press Start 2P at 8px for compact controls/body text and 10–12px for headings. The 16px CSS root retains integer 8bitcn borders. There are no runtime font CDN requests. System sans-serif fallbacks preserve unsupported Unicode glyphs.
